final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(c.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(c.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE c.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND c.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS mean_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scans, g.avg_gb_per_min, g.avg_gb_per_min - m.mean_ratio AS diff_from_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
